about_the_game: The official soundtrack for Beholder: Conductor, A Beholder series spin-off. Become a conductor of the Determination Bringer train: monitor passengers, report incidents, and carry out important Ministry assignments. developed and published by Alawar. Featuring original music composed by Deallry, this album contains all 17 tracks recorded for the game. Provided in MP3 & WAV formats.
